findings: l.1031: the proof applies lem:path_covering in Y, which needs Y connected, but the lemma does not assume Y connected. It follows (Y1 is dense and lies in p(X), which is connected since X is), so the statement is true; the proof should say so.

l.1032-1033: the proof embeds X in 'the completion' X̄ with X portly in X̄; by WP-25c a completion in the paper's sense need not exist (theo:Fox_completion_functor existence is false in general). The argument is repaired with Fox's space of ends, in which only the image of X1 = p^{-1}(Y1) needs to be portly; it is, being base^{-1}(Y1) (ends over ordinary points are realised).
questions: Partial lifts on [0,1) (resp. Q x [0,1)) are read as functions on I (resp. Q x I) continuous on {t < 1}; the value at t = 1 is ignored.

kb_proposals: Lifting a path on [0,1) through a covering: liftHomotopy over A = {t : I | t < 1} with H(s,a) = γ(s*a), then f(a) = Γ(1,a); f(0) = e by IsCoveringMap.eq_of_comp_eq (GX.exists_partial_lift).

Fox's extension property for complete spreads is now GX.exists_extend_of_isCompleteSpread (homotopy, Q locally connected) and GX.exists_extend_path_of_isCompleteSpread (path): build the end at H(q,1) from the components of tails F(N × (l,1)).

The criterion 'every partial path lift extends ⇒ complete' is GX.isCompleteSpread_of_pathLiftExtends; it needs only Y1 open ⊆ ord(Y) with p⁻¹(Y1) portly, and is reusable for (co)restrictions with GX.pathLiftExtends_restrict and GX.subset_ordY_restrict.
A (co)restriction of a spread to any LOCALLY CONNECTED subset (not only an open one) is a spread: GX.IsSpread.restrict_of_locallyConnectedSpace.
In `connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ hz` with hz in a component of a preimage, give the set and point explicitly: the elaborator otherwise unifies against the target-side set and fails.
notes: One file, 0 sorry, builds with `lake build GXScaffold.Branched.Basic` (no rebuild of GX.* or mathlib); axioms of the main theorems: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Imports GXScaffold.Spread.Completion (sibling, read-only) and through it GX.Spread.Basic / GX.Topology.Portly. The strict library is not touched. All nine labels are marked: every hypothesis is carried or weakened, none added. Two findings on the proof of lem:complete_path_carac (Y connected used but not assumed — it follows; the completion it embeds into need not exist — repaired via Fox's space of ends). File compiles warning-free, so it should be graduation-ready once GXScaffold.Spread.Completion graduates (it depends on it).
